text:
mira: bringing up quetzal11b (int4) on canary nodes. seeing intermittent OOMs for long generations (>1200 tokens). repro rate ~3% on canary.

sanjay: can you paste the container logs/snippet?

mira: here are the tail logs from the failing pod:```
2026-03-22T18:12:03Z ERROR oom at alloc_kv cache=1.2GB slot=xxxx
2026-03-22T18:12:03Z INFO request id=abc123 max_new_tokens=2048 batch=1
2026-03-22T18:12:03Z WARN fragment_count high, prefer evict
```

eli: hmm looks like large max_new_tokens + int4 kv growth. quetzal's attention pattern spikes mem fragmentation. did you enable kv_shrink? default for this model is off.

mira: not turned on for the canary. current config:```json
{
  "model": "quetzal11b",
  "quant": "int4",
  "batching": "auto",
  "max_new_tokens_default": 2048,
  "kv_shrink_policy": "off"
}
```

jen: two quick mitigations: lower default max_new_tokens to 1024 for canary + enable kv_shrink_policy: "aggressive". also consider soft-reserve for prefetched KV (e.g. 48MB) and microbatch windowing.

eli: agree. also try turning on the compact-on-evict flag we added last month (helps defragmentation after heavy generations). small perf hit but avoids OOMs.

mira: will try the following plan: 1) set max_new_tokens_default=1024 2) kv_shrink_policy=aggressive 3) compact_on_evict=true 4) enable batch_pacing: "windowed" with max_batch_delay=8ms.

ops-bot: deploy request received for canary config changes (ticket #ML-4821).

qa-squad: can we add a unit eval that runs 2x long-gen prompts (1500-2500 tokens) under load to catch regressions?

mira: yes adding eval harness now. quick note: we saw a small quality delta on a few instruction-following prompts when dropping to int4 + kv_shrink, will run a focused QA set after change.

jen: if quality regresses we can try hybrid-int6 kernel for feed-forward layers (keeps KV int4 but weights int6) —lower memory frag, small perf delta.

eli: after canary run, push metrics: OOM count, p50/p95 latency, token cost, and eval-quality delta. if OOMs drop below 0.5% and quality delta <0.7% we roll to wider.

mira: patching canary now. will update in this thread with numbers.

ops-bot: canary config applied to 3 nodes — https://infra.redwood/canaries/quetzal11b (updated) :thumbsup:

mira: initial canary results (30m): OOMs -> 3 -> 0, p95 latency +5%, token-cost -12%, small quality delta 0.4% on instruction set. looks good to me.

jen: nice. schedule a slow rollout, enable monitoring alert for OOM > 1% over 10m.

mira: will do. thanks all.
